Definition: properly, to cast together, i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become many, be or become much, be or become great; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to be or become many; 1a2) to be or become great; 1a3) to be long (of journey); 2) (Pual) ten thousands
